'''''Boba Fett: Maze of Deception''''' is the third in a series of young reader novels that chronicle the adventures of a young [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]] during the years between [[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones|''Star Wars'': Episode II ''Attack of the Clones'']] and [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'']].
